semantic_scope_screen.title: Diagram cardinality supplies an argument value to an adjacent whole

evidence.quote:
The complete official 38-surface diagram run sharpens GDT354 in both
directions.

- The exact narrow spiral-band rendering is a real local subseries: three
  adjacent pages, all with eight curved text-bearing compartments.
- The broader eight-curved-compartment family contains five pages after adding
  two decorated petal-like predecessors.
- Curved compartments are not an eight-value key. A nearby page has twelve
  curved, text-bearing lobes around a central circle.
- Four other surfaces have a clear eightfold primary division rendered as
  straight sectors or interlaced circles.

Thus the f68v3 resemblance is not an isolated doodle, but neither is it a
specific semantic match. LJS 443 demonstrates a local design vocabulary in
which eightfold systems and curved radial compartments recur, while the same
general lobe idiom also carries a different cardinality.

rivals.cardinality_argument: an independently counted diagram cardinality supplies a value to a nearby whole
rivals.reusable_geometry: the same lobe geometry recurs with different cardinalities and supplies no argument value

semantic_scope_screen.title: Caption and prose channels select different argument arity on one diagram page

evidence.quote:
Ashmole 399 supplies the strongest readable precedent so far for q13's mixed
page architecture, but not for its content or exact topology.  A medieval
medical page can combine an abstract connected system, short inscriptions
owned by individual components, one embedded humanlike figure, and dense
longer practical text.  Another abstract-system page in the same manuscript
uses predominantly continuous prose instead, showing that caption and prose
layouts can vary within one technical codex.

## What matches

| Axis | Readable Ashmole evidence | q13 f80r/f82r | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Abstract connected system | bilateral channels and component network | tubes, pools, enclosures, figures | architecture match |
| Local captions plus prose | component labels coexist with longer remedies | graphical labels coexist with paragraph prose | architecture match |
| Figure within system | one small figure in an upper oval | multiple figures in/beside connected structures | partial match |
| Conceptual rather than naturalistic rendering | source-supported for f13v/f22v | plausible for q13 hydraulic diagrams | broad format lead |

This makes a **hybrid medical-diagram plus practical-record format** more
historically concrete.  It also explains why attempting to force every q13
string into one homogeneous lexical class may be wrong: a readable analogue
can place short component captions and longer practical discourse on the same
diagram page.

rivals.channel_arity: caption units and prose units use different argument arity
rivals.homogeneous_channel: both are instances of one homogeneous lexical/argument system
